entry.name: qlim
entry.description: Slows down throughput of messages. Limiting is based on a minimum amount of time between passed message.

arguments.name: minimum
arguments.description: The minimum amount of time between successive outputs. Time can be specified in any of the time formats used in Max. If there is no argument, the minimum time is 0 milliseconds.

attributes.description: Send output only on the specified time-boundary if appropriate. This is achieved by making internal adjustments to the times used for sending output. The quantization can be specified in the following: bars.beats.units, ticks or note values.

attributes.name: usurp
attributes.digest: Usurp Mode
attributes.description: Whenis enabled and multiple messages are received that could be output, the most recently received message replaces any currently queued message. Whenis disabled, all messages received will be sent out. The difference is subtle and it is typically appropriate to leaveenabled for most situations.

messages.name: anything
messages.digest: Pass input if minimum time was met
messages.description: In left inlet: Any number, bang, or message is passed out the outlet, provided that a certain minimum time has elapsed since the previous output. Otherwise, the message is held until that amount of time has passed (or until it is overwritten by another incoming message).
